$description: Grammar Hub — canonical gamification model shared by the 3 apps + Hub. One coherent reward layer: a suite-wide day-streak + accumulated stats + badges (stored in same-origin localStorage under storage.sharedKey), plus a per-activity answer-streak that stays local to each app. Consumed per app (generate like curriculum.json / grammar-model.json). Thresholds are tunable. DUA: every reward = colour (design-tokens foundation.play) + icon + label + number, never colour alone.

storage.why: All apps live on moncholate.github.io/* (same origin, including the same-origin iframes the Hub embeds), so they can share ONE localStorage key. Relies on staying same-domain; bump progressSchema.v on any breaking change and re-sync all apps.
storage.localKeys: Ephemeral per-activity answer-streaks stay in each app's OWN keys (e.g. ql_id_streak), NOT in the shared key. Only their max feeds bestAnswerStreak.

progressSchema.practiceDays: array of ISO dates (yyyy-mm-dd) the student practiced in ANY app
progressSchema.tenses: { [tenseId]: { attempts, correct, days: [ISO dates] } } — fed ONLY by practice activities (QL Identifica, Grammaster practice), NOT the sentence builder (no right/wrong there)
progressSchema.badges: { [badgeId]: unlockedDateISO }  (for perTense badges the key is `${badgeId}:${tenseId}`)

dayStreak.rule: On any correct-graded practice, mark today in practiceDays; count = consecutive days ending today; reset to 1 if a day was skipped; best = max ever.

desc.es: Aciertos seguidos dentro de una actividad
desc.en: Correct answers in a row within an activity

answerStreak.rule: Local to each practice activity; resets on a wrong answer. Its running max is pushed to shared bestAnswerStreak for the precision badge.

desc.es: Precisión y retención por tiempo verbal

tenseMastery.rule: Each graded practice attempt on tense T updates tenses[T].attempts (+1), tenses[T].correct (+1 if right), and adds today to tenses[T].days (unique).

deferred.note: Analista — 50 oraciones analizadas (Desgramatizador). Needs a new per-app counter; add in S2 when filling Desgramatizador's gamification.

visual.dua: reward = colour + icon + label + number; respect prefers-reduced-motion; announce unlocks with aria-live.
